sections.markdown:
## C2 — Basic-driving confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A13
First to arrive goes first at an intersection, and only when two drivers arrive together does the driver on the right get the right-of-way. [A13]
Why it matters: group_hint right-of-way; prereq_hint sec03-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F06, sec03-F07.
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A14
A left-turning driver yields to oncoming traffic, while a driver entering from a driveway, private road or acceleration ramp yields to traffic already on the road. [A14]
Why it matters: group_hint right-of-way; prereq_hint sec03-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F09, sec03-F10.
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A14
Driving below the posted limit for bad conditions is legal, but exceeding the posted limit is illegal even if traffic around you is faster. [A14]
Why it matters: group_hint speed; prereq_hint sec03-F11; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F12, sec03-F14.
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A15
The ideal-condition minimum gap is 3 to 4 seconds, which grows to four or five seconds or more behind buses and delivery vans that stop often. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint following-distance; prereq_hint sec03-F18; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F17, sec03-F19.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A15
Following distance is measured in seconds against a fixed reference point, whereas stopping distance depends on reaction time, road surface, tire tread and brakes. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint following-distance; prereq_hint sec03-F17; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F18, sec03-F20.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A15
A U-turn is signaled with the left turn signal and ends in the outside, right-hand lane of the opposite direction, not the lane nearest the center. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint turning; prereq_hint sec03-F23; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F24.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A16
Passing on the right is an exception allowed only when it is safe, you stay on the road, and the other vehicle is turning left or you are on an unobstructed road with two or more lanes your way; it is never allowed on the shoulder. [A16]
Why it matters: group_hint passing; prereq_hint sec03-F25; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec03-F26, sec03-F30.
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A16
The 100-foot no-passing distance applies to intersections and railroad grade crossings always, but to bridges, elevated roads and tunnels only when your view is blocked. [A16]
Why it matters: group_hint passing; prereq_hint sec03-F28; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec03-F29, sec03-F30.
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A16
A single solid yellow center line bans passing when it is on your side of the road, while double solid yellow lines ban passing wherever they appear. [A16]
Why it matters: group_hint passing; prereq_hint sec03-F28; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F28.
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A16
The driver being passed must yield and hold speed, while the passing driver must signal and wait for both headlights in the mirror before moving back. [A16]
Why it matters: group_hint passing; prereq_hint sec03-F25; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F25, sec03-F27.
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0016]
